title: Publish plan
description: Writes that publish --plan proposes for one change request. publish --apply executes exactly these actions, and only if the head commit is still headSha.

cr.description: Change request the plan writes to.

headSha.description: Head commit the plan was made for.

actions.description: Writes in the order they are executed. An empty list means there is nothing to publish.

items.description: One write. review-comment needs path, side and line; issue needs project and title; related-tick needs entry.

id.description: Number of the action, from 1, so the user can confirm or drop single actions.

kind.description: review-comment is an inline comment, summary-comment a comment on the change request, issue a new issue, related-tick ticks an entry of Related Changes.

body.description: Text to post, in Markdown; it is secret-scanned before it is sent. Empty for related-tick.

findingId.description: Fingerprint of the finding the action publishes: the id of a reported finding.

side.description: Diff side of an inline comment.

line.description: Last line of an inline comment.

startLine.description: First line of a multi-line inline comment.

line.description: Line number, starting at 1, in the file version of the chosen side.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes, without empty, '.' or '..' segments.

runId.description: Identifier of a review run, also the name of its work directory.

sha.description: Full commit SHA, 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

side.description: Side of the diff: LEFT is the target branch version, RIGHT the change request version.

timestamp.description: UTC time in RFC 3339 format, for example 2026-11-02T10:15:00Z.
